research_question: What is the effect of manual therapy, prescribed exercises, or both, compared with minimal or no intervention (e.g. wait-and-see, advice, placebo or usual GP care), on pain intensity at the end of the intervention in adults with lateral elbow pain (tennis elbow)?
treatment_label: Manual therapy, prescribed exercises, or combined therapy
control_label: Minimal or no intervention (wait-and-see, advice, placebo, or usual GP care)
outcome_description: Pain intensity at the end of the intervention period, measured on a 0 to 10 scale (or converted from a 0 to 100 VAS by dividing by 10), where lower scores represent lower pain intensity
positive_direction: A positive effect size indicates greater pain reduction (lower pain intensity) favoring manual therapy/exercise over minimal or no intervention
search_queries: tennis elbow manual therapy exercise controlled trial
lateral epicondylitis exercise physical therapy wait and see trial
lateral elbow pain manual therapy exercise pain outcome trial
inclusion_criteria: Adults diagnosed with lateral elbow pain (tennis elbow or lateral epicondylitis)
Randomized or controlled trials evaluating manual therapy, prescribed exercises, or both compared to minimal or no intervention (e.g., wait-and-see, advice, placebo, or usual GP care)
Quantitative measurement of pain intensity at the end of the intervention period (e.g., visual analogue scale or numerical rating scale)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, commentaries, and theoretical papers are excluded)

No comparison between eligible intervention (manual therapy and/or exercise) and minimal/no intervention (e.g. comparisons limited to glucocorticoid injection, braces alone, or other active treatments)
No quantitative outcome data to calculate mean difference in pain intensity at the end of intervention (means, standard deviations, sample sizes, or convertible statistics missing)
Completely unrelated to adults with lateral elbow pain (tennis elbow / lateral epicondylitis)
moderators_to_extract: Intervention modality (manual therapy alone, exercise alone, or combined manual therapy and exercise)
Control condition type (wait-and-see, placebo, advice, or usual GP care)
effect_size_note: Mean difference (MD) on a 0-10 scale; 0-100 VAS scores converted to 0-10 by dividing by 10. Evaluated strictly at the end of the intervention period.
